Presale means you buy a home before it is built, and you take possession when it completes. This page lists every Burnaby presale project on my list that is scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2029, with the developer, type, size and deposit where the sources publish them.

What newer homes in Burnaby have sold for
Looking at November 2025 to October 2026, Forest Glen BS had the newest sold duplexes in Burnaby, built in 2026 at the median, with 13 sales at a median of $1,504,000.

9 of 75 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Forest Glen BS duplexes (built 2026), Capitol Hill BN duplexes (built 2026), Sperling-Duthie duplexes (built 2025) and Burnaby Lake duplexes (built 2025).

blocks.text: Burnaby presale projects at a glance

The list holds 21 presale projects in Burnaby with estimated completion between 2027 and 2029: 6 in 2027, 13 in 2028, 2 in 2029. By type, that is 18 condo projects, 3 mixed condo and townhome projects.

1 of the 21 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at Bassano (Phase 1 / Tower 1): from $800,000. For the other 20, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 10 of the 21.
Developers with more than one project here: Concord Pacific (3), Anthem Properties (2), Anthem Properties (Anthem and Kingsett Capital per Livabl) (2), Shape Properties (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Reign at Metrotown at 617 homes.

faq.q: How many presale projects are completing in Burnaby between 2027 and 2029?
faq.a: 21 projects are on my list as of November 2026: 6 completing in 2027, 13 completing in 2028, 2 completing in 2029. The list covers projects marketed publicly. Projects sold only through private channels may be missing.

faq.q: What kinds of presale homes are being built in Burnaby?
faq.a: The mix is 18 condo projects, 3 mixed condo and townhome projects.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Burnaby Presale?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Burnaby Presale?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.
